opening.text: Maria stands by your desk, tablet in hand, reviewing the day's briefing materials. She looks up as you enter, her expression a mix of professional competence and genuine warmth.
opening.speaker: narrator

segments.speaker: maria
segments.text: Good morning, Senator. I've prepared the briefing for today's press conference. We need to discuss your position on the Education Reform Bill before the reporters arrive.

choices.text: "I appreciate your thoroughness. You're a lifesaver."
"Just give me the highlights. I'll figure it out in the conference."

segments.speaker: maria
segments.text: The bill has strong support from teachers' unions, but the opposition is framing it as federal overreach. Your vote could be decisive. How do you want to position yourself?

choices.text: "I support the bill. Education is a federal priority."
"I need to hear more from my constituents first."

segments.speaker: maria
segments.text: She smiles at your appreciation, a genuine moment of connection in the busy morning. "I try to keep you prepared. That's what I'm here for."

choices.text: "You're far more than just my press secretary."

segments.speaker: maria
segments.text: "The press will be here in ten minutes. Let me know if you need anything else before we face them." She gives you a final look—professional, but with something warmer underneath.

choices.text: "Thanks, Maria. I'll see you in the conference room."

consequences.high_trust: Maria will be more cooperative in crisis (Chapter 6)
consequences.high_attraction: Maria may have complicated feelings (affects Chapter 6-7)
consequences.low_trust: Maria may not fully support you in crisis
